title: ToolRunSchema
description: Source of record for the ⏯️tool-run framework module: run identity, lifecycle states, events and the pure reducer transition, progress and step ring, trace pages, trace delta, ticks, the static ToolRunDefinition and the lifecycle, trace page and tick fixtures. Wire names are camelCase; u64 values are JSON integers; byte strings are lowercase hex.

LocalizedLabel.title: LocalizedLabel
LocalizedLabel.description: Locale × terminology matrix, the wire shape of the framework LocalizedLabel.

ToolRunSlot.title: ToolRunSlot
ToolRunSlot.description: The reducer's view of the single per-instance ledger slot. Absence (null) means no run.

ToolRunEventKey.title: ToolRunEventKey
ToolRunEventKey.description: Matrix column of an event: the event type, except that abort with publishing=true is keyed abortWhilePublishing.

ToolRunStepRing.title: ToolRunStepRing
ToolRunStepRing.description: Newest ≤ 64 steps, oldest first, overwrite-oldest, identical consecutive steps coalesced into repeat.

ToolRunTracePage.title: ToolRunTracePage
ToolRunTracePage.description: Columnar pack record body: identity, page, opKinds u8, keys u64le, verdicts u8, reasons u16le, subjectKinds u8, meshes u32le, shapes u32le, entities u64le, floats f32le. Empty columns are omitted.

ToolRunTraceDelta.title: ToolRunTraceDelta
ToolRunTraceDelta.description: One refresh worth of trace pages for a window: clear=true means drop every record before applying pages; next is the cursor page to echo back.

ToolRunTraceCursor.title: ToolRunTraceCursor
ToolRunTraceCursor.description: Echoed by a renderer in its window instance view state; page is the next page it expects.

ToolRunTick.title: ToolRunTick
ToolRunTick.description: Pack record body carried by a RetainedJobPayload page: retractTo applies before appendOps.

payload.description: Opaque plugin bytes the run's windows read back through the run view; the newest tick carrying one wins.

windows.description: Window kind ids whose bodies render this run's state; every tick refreshes them next to the ToolRun panel, and no other window.

matrix.description: Every (slot state, event key) pair: 10 × 18 rows. A legal row names to/effect/generation/commits; an illegal row names its rejection.

settingsPointers.description: Settings pointer resolution (RFC 6901) over one document: every row names the value the pointer resolves to, or null when it names nothing; malformed pointers are refused by `ToolRunDefinition.validate`.

admission.description: Start admission among an instance's runs (§2.2 invariant 5): one non-terminal mutating run per actor; read-only runs run concurrently, one per (tool, window). A row names busy, or the indices of the terminal runs the start replaces.

panelGroups.description: ToolRun panel group keys: which keys name a run, and the runs a rendered panel adds to those a host has seen (it reveals the panel for them).

ToolRunSettingsPointer.title: ToolRunSettingsPointer
ToolRunSettingsPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a settings document: empty, or `/`-separated reference tokens where `~` only appears as `~0` or `~1`.

ToolRunSettingsReads.title: ToolRunSettingsReads
ToolRunSettingsReads.description: The settings a run's jobs read (§3.3): pointers into the app config document and, per window kind id, into that kind's window config documents. `settingsChanged` fires only when a value behind one of them changes; absent or empty reads no settings.

ToolRunLane.title: ToolRunLane
ToolRunLane.description: What a run occupies on its document instance for its local actor: every mutating run shares the one mutating lane; a read-only run owns the lane of its tool on its window instance.
